# BLO-49139: remove the adapter's SIGTERM listener

Tracking: [BLO-49139](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-49139)

`ensureSigtermHandler()` installed `process.once("SIGTERM", () => process.kill(process.pid, "SIGTERM"))` the first time `execute()` launched a Job. It meant to be a no-op that leaves Jobs alive (FAR-107), but it re-raised the signal. Node removes each `once` wrapper as it fires, including the host server's own `once` handler. So the re-raised SIGTERM found no listener, and the default action killed the paperclip worker mid-drain, ~0.7 s after the first SIGTERM and before the host's `drainInFlightRunSetup` could hold the pod. Runs claimed in the seconds before a rollout were stranded as `process_lost`.

The listener is deleted. Shutdown belongs to the host. Leaving Jobs alive for reattach needs no handler at all. Guarded by a test in `execute.test.ts` that fails if any `process.on/once(...SIG...)` or `process.kill(process.pid` comes back.

Version: `0.2.6-blockcast.12` → `0.2.6-blockcast.13`.
